title: Gravitational Acceleration
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly derive and calculate the gravitational acceleration at the surface of the moon as g = 1.62 m/s^2.

title: Escape Velocity
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly derive and calculate the escape velocity from the moon as v_0 = 2.37 x 10^3 m/s.

title: Use of Constants
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly use the gravitational constant G and the mass and radius of the moon in their calculations.

title: Energy Conservation
description: Important Criteria: The student must apply the principle of conservation of energy to derive the escape velocity.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Final Answer Format
description: Optional Criteria: The student should present final answers clearly and in the correct format.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common sign errors in the energy equations.

title: Calculation Mistakes
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid arithmetic errors in the calculations of g and v_0.
